name: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited
summary: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions Limited engages in development and maintenance of renewable energy projects, such as solar and wind power solutions for commercial and industrial customers. The company operates in two segments, Renewable Energy Power Sales Segment and Renewable Energy Services Segment. The company delivers renewable energy through wind, solar, and hybrid farms, rooftop and ground-mounted solar projects, floating solar, and solar carports. It also offers off-site renewable energy solutions, such as STU-connected and CTU-connected off-site solutions.
